text: I'm a big fan of home-made food, especially Kazakh dishes like beshbarmak and baursaks. I also really like spicy food — Korean and Indian dishes are probably my favourites when I eat out, because they have so much more flavour than typical fast food.

tips.en: First a general answer, then specific dishes — the answer sounds developed.
tips.kk: Алдымен жалпы жауап, сосын нақты тағамдар — жауап толық естіледі.
tips.ru: Сначала общий ответ, потом конкретные блюда — так ответ звучит развёрнуто.
tips.example: especially Kazakh dishes like beshbarmak and baursaks

tips.en: Explains the choice by comparing it with fast food.
tips.example: so much more flavour than typical fast food

note.en: A phrasal verb: eating at a restaurant or café.

questions.followUp: Is there any food you do not like?
questions.question: What kind of food do you like?

text: Not as often as I'd like, to be honest. On weekdays I usually just make something quick, like pasta or an omelette, because I get home quite late. At weekends, though, I try to cook something more ambitious, and sometimes I invite a couple of friends over.

tips.en: Contrasting two situations makes the answer complete without padding.
tips.kk: Екі жағдайдың қарама-қайшылығы жауапты артық сөзсіз толық етеді.
tips.ru: Контраст двух ситуаций делает ответ полным без лишних слов.
tips.example: At weekends, though, I try to cook something more ambitious

tips.en: Not as often as I’d like is a polite way to say “rarely”.
tips.kk: Not as often as I’d like — «сирек» деудің сыпайы тәсілі.
tips.ru: Not as often as I’d like — вежливый способ сказать «редко».
tips.example: Not as often as I'd like

note.en: A phrasal verb: ask friends to come to your home.
note.ru: «Позвать пару друзей в гости» — фразовый глагол.

phrases.text: invite a couple of friends over

questions.question: Do you often cook at home?

text: My grandmother, mostly. When I was a child I used to spend summers at her house in the village, and she'd let me help her make bread and soups. She never used recipes, so I learned to cook by watching and tasting rather than measuring everything.

tips.en: Used to and would are accurate grammar for past habits.
tips.kk: Used to және would — өткендегі әдеттерге дәл грамматика.
tips.ru: Used to и would — точная грамматика для привычек в прошлом.
tips.example: I used to spend summers at her house in the village

tips.en: The detail about recipes makes the answer personal and memorable.
tips.kk: Рецепттер туралы дерек жауапты жеке әрі есте қаларлық етеді.
tips.ru: Деталь про рецепты делает ответ личным и запоминающимся.

questions.followUp: Do you enjoy cooking with other people?
questions.question: Who taught you to cook?

text: Generally I prefer eating at home. It's healthier and much cheaper, and I like knowing exactly what's in my food. That said, eating out is great for special occasions — there's nothing better than a long dinner with friends at a good restaurant after a busy week.

tips.en: A clear choice, then three short reasons joined with and.
tips.kk: Бірден таңдау, сосын and арқылы үш қысқа себеп.
tips.ru: Сразу выбор, затем три коротких причины через and.

tips.en: Shows that the other option has advantages too.
tips.kk: Басқа нұсқаның да артықшылығы бар екенін көрсетеді.
tips.ru: Показывает, что у другого варианта тоже есть плюсы.
tips.example: That said, eating out is great for special occasions

note.en: Softens the claim: usually, not always.
An emotional way to say “the best is”.

questions.followUp: How often do you eat out?
questions.question: Do you prefer eating at home or in restaurants?

text: Quite a lot, actually. As a child I ate whatever my parents cooked, which was mostly meat and potatoes. Now I eat far more vegetables and fish, partly because I've become more interested in health, and partly because there's a much wider choice of food in the shops these days.

tips.en: Past simple for childhood and present for today — a clear structure.
tips.kk: Балалық шаққа past simple, бүгінге present — анық құрылым.
tips.ru: Past simple для детства и present для сегодня — ясная структура.
tips.example: As a child I ate whatever my parents cooked

tips.en: Partly… and partly neatly gives two reasons.
tips.kk: Partly… and partly — екі себепті ұқыпты береді.
tips.ru: Partly… and partly — аккуратно даёт две причины.
tips.example: partly because I've become more interested in health

note.en: Stresses that the change is noticeable.

questions.followUp: Do you think you eat healthily now?
questions.question: Has your diet changed since you were a child?
